purpose: Protects the audit remediation suite. Every test is named after the finding it closes; losing one silently loses the evidence that a critical finding stays closed.
policy: All control intent and traceability must be preserved. Documented PostgreSQL-specific adaptations are permitted, but no assertion may be weakened or removed without approval recorded in tests/ADAPTATIONS.md.

baseline.commit_note: POC baseline, branch phase-0a/foundations, before any port work
baseline.collected_cases_note: 348 is the pytest-collected count after parametrisation expands 6 files; 220 is the count of `def test_` functions. Both are real and the Definition of Done refers to the function count.
